title: Boy in Backyard Water Basin, 1955 B&W Suburban Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Gary Alan Steinmetz in pan of water with boat. Sept. 10, 1955
description: A charming black and white snapshot taken on September 10, 1955, capturing a young boy named Gary Alan Steinmetz sitting inside a small wash basin filled with water in his backyard. Next to the tub lies a small toy boat on the grass. The background features typical mid-century suburban architecture with brick houses, a metal clothesline, and a chain-link fence, offering a nostalgic slice of American childhood during the 1950s post-war era.
